Layer.StartUpdateTransitionP2MessageCommand: %function(self) self:stoptweening() self:sleep(0.02*1) self:decelerate(0.05) self:x(35) self:diffusealpha(0) self:queuecommand('UpdateRadarValue') end
Layer.UpdateRadarValueCommand: %function(self) self:decelerate(0.05) self:diffusealpha(1) self:x(20) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:settext( RadarValue(PLAYER_2,5) ) else self:settext( ' ' ) end end
